Thanks for contributing. For a new entry:

- [ ] One YAML file added under `data/entries/`, following [docs/SCHEMA.md](../docs/SCHEMA.md)
- [ ] Every field verified from the source (repo, LICENSE file, paper) — `unknown` where not
- [ ] `description` states what the project does, with no quality judgments
- [ ] Did **not** hand-edit `README.md` or `entries/` (both are generated; run `python3 scripts/render.py`)
